title: Listening Drill — Canal wildlife records
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Canal wildlife records
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on recording wildlife on a canal. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with an open day. At the time our biggest obstacle was poor access. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered dawn activity. It helped us improve visit timing. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll try a quieter stretch of the canal. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
